findings.evidence: grep for `IsBigO.of_bound|inv_anti₀` hits Consistency.lean:139,144,171,174 and Asymptotics.lean:177,181 with the same three-line body.
findings.fix: Extract one helper next to `isBigO_harmonic_sub_log_sub_eulerMascheroniConstant_inv`, e.g. `theorem isBigO_inv_natCast_add (a : ℝ) : (fun n : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) + a)⁻¹) =O[atTop] fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)⁻¹`, and derive the three products from it with `IsBigO.mul`/`isBigO_const_mul_self` instead of fresh `nlinarith` bounds at each site.
findings.issue: The fact "a rational function falling like 1/N is O(1/N)" is re-proved inline three times by the same `refine IsBigO.of_bound c; filter_upwards; rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg …]; exact inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (by nlinarith)` pattern: `hrat` at 138-144, `hle₁` at 169-171, `hle₂` at 172-174. The identical pattern already exists at Mathematics/HarmonicSum/Asymptotics.lean:176-181, so the reusable fact stays hidden in four private copies.

findings.evidence: Consistency.lean:175-179; Mathlib positivity docstring: "use a local hypothesis of the form `0 ≤ e`, `0 < e` or `e ≠ 0`" (Positivity/Core.lean:573).
findings.fix: Either discharge the norm side conditions explicitly (`Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity [h₁])` or `by linarith [h₁, …]`) or add a one-line comment saying `h₁` is what lets `positivity` see the first summand as nonnegative.
findings.issue: `h₁ : 0 ≤ 1 / ((N - 1) * N)` (175-177) is never named again; it is consumed invisibly by the `by positivity` side goal of `Real.norm_of_nonneg` on line 178, via positivity's local-hypothesis fallback (`compareHyp`, Mathlib/Tactic/Positivity/Core.lean:460). Same trick inside h₁ itself, where `this : 0 ≤ N - 1` feeds positivity. A reader sees an unused `have` and cannot tell why `positivity` succeeds on a term with a subtraction in the denominator.

findings.evidence: upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/ContinuousOn.lean:741 `continuousOn_id : ContinuousOn id s`; :745 `continuousOn_id' (s) : ContinuousOn (fun x : α => x) s`.
findings.fix: Use `(continuousOn_id' _)` (Mathlib/Topology/ContinuousOn.lean:745, stated for `fun x => x` precisely for this) or `(by fun_prop)` for consistency.
findings.issue: `hφ.continuousOn_mul (g := fun z => z) continuousOn_id` passes `ContinuousOn id s` where `ContinuousOn (fun z => z) s` is expected, relying on `id` unfolding; every other `continuousOn_mul` argument in this proof uses `(by fun_prop)`.

summary: The supersymmetric-relation proof is clean, but the two large-N proofs re-derive the same ad-hoc `IsBigO.of_bound`/`inv_anti₀`/`nlinarith` rational-decay bound three times (a fourth copy already sits in Asymptotics.lean), and one step is load-bearing only through positivity's silent local-hypothesis fallback.
